content.value_statement: Partnership outreach can be slow and inconsistent across many contacts. This skill creates tailored messages, follow-up plans, negotiation guidance, and a clear relationship pipeline.
actual_capabilities: Draft personalized outreach for creators, journalists, analysts, and launch partners.
Create short direct-message and formal email versions of a pitch.
Build a four-touch follow-up cadence with clear timing and exit points.
Prepare negotiation scripts for rate, scope, and deliverable discussions.
Organize outreach stages, conversion measures, and next actions in a pipeline tracker.
limitations: It does not send emails, direct messages, or update external systems by itself.
It relies on user-provided facts and does not verify audience data or past partnerships.
It does not create final contracts or provide legal advice.
Users remain responsible for consent, accuracy, and platform communication rules.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator campaign
use_cases.description: Prepare tailored pitches and a follow-up schedule for selected creators before a product launch.

use_cases.title: Re-engage a past partner
use_cases.description: Write a respectful message that references previous work and proposes a new collaboration.

use_cases.title: Handle a budget objection
use_cases.description: Compare the requested rate with the budget and prepare scope-adjustment options.

prompt_templates.title: Write a first outreach message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a friendly outreach message to [creator] for [campaign]. Include their platform, niche, offer, deliverables, budget, and deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Create a follow-up cadence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-touch follow-up sequence for [creator] after no reply. Use Day 0, Day 3, Day 7, and Day 14. Keep each message shorter than the last.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a negotiation response
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me respond to [creator] who requested [rate] while my budget is [budget]. Offer fair scope, deliverable, and timing alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Build an outreach pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outreach pipeline for these targets: [list]. Include stage, owner, last contact, next action, proposed terms, and conversion metrics.

output_examples.input: Write outreach for an eco-lifestyle creator for a skincare launch.
output: Personalization points based on supplied content and audience details.
A primary email, a short direct message, and a clear optional collaboration offer.
A follow-up schedule with a respectful opt-out point.

output_examples.input: Help negotiate when a creator requests more than the campaign budget.
output: A concise acknowledgement of the creator’s rate.
Three options that adjust scope, deliverables, or timing.
A response table for common objections and next steps.

best_practices: Use verified details about each contact before personalizing a message.
State the offer, deliverables, compensation, and timing clearly.
Limit follow-ups and make declining easy.
anti_patterns: Do not invent audience metrics, past partnerships, quotes, or campaign results.
Do not send repeated messages after a clear refusal or opt-out.
Do not promise compensation or contract terms without approval.

faq.question: Can this skill send outreach messages?
faq.answer: No. It drafts outreach materials. You review and send them through your approved communication tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target, platform, campaign, deliverables, budget, timeline, and verified personalization details.

faq.question: Can I use it for journalists or analysts?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the approved story angle, facts, and any embargo terms before drafting the pitch.

faq.question: How many follow-ups does it recommend?
faq.answer: It supports a four-touch cadence and recommends archiving after the final planned follow-up.

faq.question: Does it negotiate contracts?
faq.answer: It prepares discussion scripts and options. Use qualified legal review for final agreements.

faq.question: Does it verify creator data?
faq.answer: No. Validate audience data, contact details, and partnership history before using the output.
